review_scope: Read-only source, full catalog/plan, Chinese brief/detail and English brief/detail review of five actual local gpt-oss:20b diagnostic results. No model, service or production database actions.
overall: No confirmed P1/P2 source-fabrication, supply-demand sign, timing or rendered decision inconsistency in these completed five cases. P3 metadata/secondary-fact coverage issues remain; this is not production API acceptance or exhaustive semantic ground truth.

semantic_observations: Troll and Åsgard notice constraints remain conditional capacity risks, not measured lost flow; Troll 9.6 to 7.6 revision is separate downside relief.
Åsgard related positive notices are grouped with maximum contribution 1.36, rather than summing mcm/d or articles.

The Cheniere future Sabine Pass liquefaction expansion supports a global-LNG future-supply downside mechanism, contribution -0.30; the SPA and old EPC contract are not made into present gas output or incremental final demand.
OneSubsea is technical background with zero supply mechanism, correcting the unsupported technology-to-European-upstream expansion in formal 81e9.

N2 region_scope=europe and supply_chain_role=upstream are inaccurate metadata for US liquefaction/export; actual rendered text remains future upstream/export and the weight scope is future_expectation, with no claim of European local gas or observed cargo.

N5 corporate_contract is an imprecise classification of technical survey work; the proposed import-terminal background is not separately normalized. There is no current output, gas-production commitment or global demand increase asserted.
Jackdaw is future approval in the UK/European gas system, not observed production.
Current planned and future planned/unplanned Troll notices remain distinct. Future 13.6 and 13.0 are not added to current 13.0 measured loss.
Risk group +1.20, shortening -0.30 and future supply -0.15 derive score +0.75; up is consistent. Direction is not judged against a desired label distribution.
The selected EPCM fact is commercial engineering work; LNG Canada awards the assignment and Tecnicas Reunidas performs it. Contract value is not gas volume.

The full stored article also has earlier Phase2 FID and five additional compressor-station development facts that were not separately normalized in this run. This is incomplete secondary-fact coverage, not a fabricated production/TTF pressure claim.
Future Gassco positive risk max 0.18 minus revision relief 0.10 gives net 0.08, flat; close up derives a frozen same-contract intraday baseline, not the corporate award.
The exact source says have resumed gas production. It is source-reported physical resumption, not a future approval or supply loss.
No metered volume or European delivery quantity is supplied or invented. The old regional story remains background with zero current-window contribution.
The up close comes only from the frozen October same-contract reference baseline. This is a historical mechanism diagnostic, not an April contemporaneous forecast or accuracy result.
The source price observation (summer Henry Hub lower by 6 percent) and hot-weather power demand increase are separate facts.
Neither the price observation nor old US weather is turned into current European physical demand or supply. Both remain zero-weight historical regional background.
The conditional bullish scenario requires new independent evidence establishing the European/global-LNG link; the close up is the frozen October baseline, not a historical backtest.
